items.text: An Paulo, andikonu kaka jaote ma ok oor gi teko kata dwaro mar dhano, to mana gi teko mar Yesu Kristo gi Nyasaye Wuora mane ochiere oa kuom joma otho.
Andikonu kaachiel gi jowete duto man koda,
Un kanisa mar jo-Galatia.
Ngʼwono kod kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo,
Yesu nochiwore nikech richowa mondo ogonywa waa e kethruok mag ndalogi, kaluwore gi dwaro mar Nyasachwa kendo Wuonwa.
Duongʼ mondo odogne Nyasaye manyaka chiengʼ. Amin.
Onge Injili machielo
Awuoro ahinya kaka uselokoru piyo piyo nono, mi uweyo Jal mane oluongou kuom ngʼwono mar Kristo, kendo koro uluwo Injili mopogore gi mane opuonju,
ma chutho ok en Injili. Kuom adiera nitie jomoko marundo pachu ka gitemo mondo gilok Injili mar Kristo obed gimoro nono.
To ka ngʼato dipuonju Injili machielo mopogore gi mano mane wapuonjou, bed ni en wan, kata malaika moro moa e polo, to mondo okwongʼe nyaka chiengʼ.
Mana kaka wasewacho e kaka achako awacho kendo: Ka ngʼato koro yalonu Injili ma opogore gi mane urwako, to Nyasaye mondo okwongʼe nyaka chiengʼ!
Uparo ni koro adwaro pak moa kuom dhano? Ooyo, adwaro pak moa kuom Nyasaye. Koso uparo ni atemo moro dhano? Kane bed ni pod ne adwaro moro dhano, to dine ok abedo jatich Kristo.
Nyasaye oluongo Paulo
Jowetena, adwaro ni mondo ungʼe ni Injili mane ayalonu ok en gimoro ma dhano ema ochuogo.
Ne ok ayude kuom dhano moro amora, to bende ne ok opuonjago. Yesu Kristo owuon ema nofwenyona wachno.
Nyaka bed ni usewinjo kaka ne achal kane pod aluwo kit lemo mar jo-Yahudi, kaka ne asando kanisa mar Nyasaye gi gero mokalo apima, kendo ne atemo mondo atieke chuth.
Jo-Yahudi mangʼeny ma mbesena ne aloyo kuom lony e kit lemo marwa, kendo ne aketo chunya mar rito chike duto mag kwerena.
To ka Nyasaye, mane owala mi oketa tenge kaka gir tichne kane pok onywola, kendo mane oluonga kuom ngʼwonone, nohero
mondo ofwenyna Wuode, mondo ayal Wach Maber e kind joma ok jo-Yahudi, to ne ok apenjo ngʼato angʼata,
kendo ne ok adhi Jerusalem mondo ane jogo mane okuongona bedo joote, to ne adhi moriere tir nyaka e piny jo-Arabu eka bangʼe naduogo Damaski.
To bangʼ higni adek ne adhi nyaka Jerusalem mondo angʼera gi Petro, kendo ne adak kode kuom ndalo apar gabich.
Ne ok aneno kata achiel kuom joote mamoko, makmana Jakobo ma owadgi Ruoth.
Awachonu Adier e nyim Nyasaye ni weche ma andikonugi ok gin miriambo.
Bangʼe ne adhi e gwenge mag Siria kod Kilikia.
E kindeno kanisa man Judea moyie kuom Kristo ne pok oyanga malongʼo ni an ngʼa.
Negisewinjo mana wach niya, "Ngʼat ma yande sandowa bende tinde yalo kuom yie ma notemo ketho e kinde mosekalo."
Kendo mano nomiyo gimiyo Nyasaye duongʼ nikech an.

items.text: Joote mamoko orwako Paulo
Bangʼ higni apar gangʼwen ne achako adok Jerusalem, ka wan gi Barnaba kendo Tito bende ne wadhigo.

Ne adhi nikech fweny mane ayudo, ka aketonegi ler kuom Injili mane ayalo ni joma ok jo-Yahudi. To ne atimo mano lingʼ-lingʼ ni jogo mane chalo jotelo, nimar ne aluor ni dipo ka tija mar lando Injili obet kayiem nono.
To kata Tito, mane ni koda, ne ochun mondo oter nyangu, kata obedo ni ne en ja-Yunani.
Nobet kamano, nikech jomoko mawuondore ni jowete nobiro kanyo lingʼ-lingʼ mondo onon ane thuolo manade ma wan-go kuom bedo jo-Kristo Yesu, nikech jogi ne dwaro lokowa wasumbini.
To ne ok waweyonegi thuolo kata matin, mondo eka adiera mar Injili kik lalnu.
Ne ok adewo wach jogo mane nenore ka jotelo, nimar ne ok gimiya wach moro manyien nikech Nyasaye ok odewo nenruok ma oko mar dhano.
Kar timo kamano to negineno ni Nyasaye ne osemiya tich mar yalo Injili ne joma ok jo-Yahudi, mana kaka Petro bende nosemi tich mar yalo ni jo-Yahudi.
Nikech Nyasaye achiel mane tiyo gi Petro e yalone kaka jaote e kind jo-Yahudi ema bende ne tiyo koda kaka jaote ni joma ok jo-Yahudi.

Jogo mane ji oyiego kaka sirni, ma gin; Jakobo, Petro kod Johana, noriwa lwedo kaachiel gi Barnaba kane gineno ngʼwono mane omiya. Ne giyie mondo wadhi wayal ni joma ok jo-Yahudi, ka gin to gidhi ir jo-Yahudi.
Gimoro achiel mane gikwayowa mondo kik wiwa wilgo ne en ni mondo wadhi nyime gi konyo joma odhier, gima an awuon ne aikora timo.
Paulo okwero Petro
Kane Petro obiro Antiokia, ne akwere e wangʼe nikech kethone ne nenore ratiro.
Ka jo-Israel moko ne pod ok obiro koa ir Jakobo, Petro ne thoro chiemo gi joma ok jo-Yahudi. To kane gichopo, Petro nongʼwony mi opogore gi joma ok jo-Yahudi nikech ne oluorogi.
Jo-Yahudi mamoko bende nodonjo kode e wuondruokneno, mi nyaka Barnaba bende noriwore kode e wuondruokno.

Kane aneno ni wuondruokgino opogore gi adiera mar Injili, ne awacho ne Petro ka giduto giwinjo niya, "Ka in iwuon in ja-Yahudi, to itimo timbe joma ok jo-Yahudi, koro marangʼo ichuno joma ok jo-Yahudi mondo oluw timbe jo-Yahudi?
"Wan wawegi nonywolwa jo-Yahudi to ok joma ok jo-Yahudi ma joricho,

wangʼeyo ni dhano ok nyal ket kare kuom mako Chik, to mana kuom yie kuom Yesu Kristo. Omiyo kata mana wan bende waseketo yiewa kuom Kristo Yesu, mondo eka oketwa kare kuom yie kuom Kristo, to ok kuom mako chik, nikech onge ngʼama ibiro ket kare nikech mako chik.
"Kapo ni wan mwaseyie kuom Kristo mondo oketwa kare ema pod yudore ni wan joricho, to mano dinyis ni Kristo jiwo richo e ngimawa koso? Ok kamano ngangʼ!
Ka achako agero gik mane amuko, to mano nyiso malongʼo ni an jaketh chik.
"Nikech korka chik to ne asetho kuom chik mondo eka abed mangima ne Nyasaye.

Osegura kaachiel gi Kristo, kendo an koro ok ema angima, to Kristo ema ngima kuoma. Ngima makoro angimago e ringra an-go mana kuom yie ma ayiego kuom Wuod Nyasaye, mane ohera kendo ochiwore owuon ni an.
Ok anyal kawo ngʼwono Nyasaye ka gir tugo, nikech ka dipo ni ngima makare inyalo yudo kuom mako Chik, to kare Kristo notho kayiem nono!"

items.text: Yie kod rito Chik
Yaye jo-Galatia, mofuwogi! En ngʼa moseirou? Un mane onyisu wach tho mar Yesu Kristo maler mana ka gima ne unene gi wangʼu kigure!
Adwaro ni unyisa wach achielni kende: Bende ne uyudo Roho Maler kuom rito Chik koso nikech nuyie wach mane uwinjo?
Bende en adier ni ufuwo kamano? Bangʼ chako gi Roho, ere kaka koro unyagoru mar chopo ngima mar Kristo e yor ringruok?
Usesandoru malich kamano mana kayiem adier, ooyo ok apar ni kamano?
Bende Nyasaye dimiu Rohone mi otim honnige e dieru nikech urito Chik, koso nikech uyie kuom gik mane uwinjo?
Paruruane kuom Ibrahim: "Ibrahim noyie kuom Nyasaye kendo mano nomiyo okwane kaka ngʼama kare."
Wachni puonjo ni joma oyie gin nyithind Ibrahim.
Nosewach e muma chon ni Nyasaye noket joma ok jo-Yahudi kare kuom yie kendo nolando Injili motelo ni Ibrahim niya, "Ogendini duto nogwedhi nikech in."
Omiyo joma nigi yie yudo gweth kaachiel gi Ibrahim ngʼat yie.
Jogo duto motenore kuom rito Chik ni e bwo kwongʼ, nikech ondiki niya, "Okwongʼ ngʼato ka ngʼato ma ok chop chike duto mondiki e kitap Chik."
Nenore malongʼo ni onge ngʼama inyalo keto kare e nyim Nyasaye nikech omako Chik, nikech, "Ngʼat makare nobed mangima kuom yie."
To Chik owuon ok otenore kuom yie, nikech Muma wacho niya, "Ngʼat moluwo chikegi nobed mangima kuomgi."
Kristo to noresowa kuom kwongʼ ma Chik kelo, ka en owuon nobedonwa kaka ngʼama okwongʼ nikech wan, mana kaka ondiki niya, "Okwongʼ ngʼato ka ngʼato molier e yath."
Noresowa mondo gweth mane Nyasaye omiyo Ibrahim ochop ni joma ok jo-Yahudi kuom Kristo Yesu, mondo kuom yie wan duto wanwangʼ singo mar Nyasaye, ma en Roho Maler.
Chik kod singruok

Jowetena, we koro alernu tiend wachni ka akonyora gi gima timore pile pile. Wach mwapimoni chalo kama: Ka ji ariyo owinjore e wach moro, to ok oyiene ngʼato badhore ni chopo singruokno kata mondo ngʼato omedie wach moro manyien.
Singruokgi notimne Ibrahim kod kothe. Ndiko ok owacho gi nyikwaye, tiende ni ji mangʼeny, to mana ni notime gi "kothi"
ma en Kristo.
Tiend gima awacho ema: Chik mane Nyasaye ochiwo higni mia angʼwen gi piero adek bangʼe ok nyal ketho winjruok ma Nyasaye nokwongo timo ma mi oketh singruok mane otimo motelo.
Nimar ka Nyasaye miyowa girkeni mana kuom mako Chik, to mano nyiso ni ok wayudgi kuom singruok. To Nyasaye, kuom ngʼwonone, nochiwo gwethne ni Ibrahim kuom singruok.
To koro ere tij Chik? Chik nomedi mondo onyis dhano kaka en jaketho, nyaka chop kinde ma nyakwar Ibrahim mane osingi nobi. Malaika nokelo Chik moketo e lwet jathek.
To jathek ok chungʼ kar ngʼat achiel; to Nyasaye to en achiel.

Wanyalo wacho ni Chik mane Nyasaye ochiwo ogwenyore gi singruok ma notimo gi joge koso? Ooyo, ok nyal bet kamano. Nimar kapo ni Chik mane ochiwno ne nyalo chiwo ngima to mano nyiso ni Chik ne nyalo miyo dhano bedo kare.
To Muma wacho ratiro ni piny duto ni e twech mar richo omiyo joma oyie kuom Yesu Kristo kende ema yudo gino mane Nyasaye osingo.
Kane yie pok obiro, Chik notweyowa waduto, kendo noloronwa yor konyruok, nyaka kinde ma yor yie nofwenyore.
Omiyo Chik nomi teko mondo oritwa nyaka chop Kristo bi, mondo eka ketwa kare kuom yie.
To ka koro yie osebiro, to koro ok wan e bwo chik.
Nyithind Nyasaye
Un duto un nyithind Nyasaye nikech uyie kuom Kristo Yesu,
nimar un duto mosebatisu kuom Kristo userwakoru gi Kristo.
Kuom mano koro onge pogruok e kind ja-Yahudi, kata ja-Yunani; wasumbini kata joma ni thuolo, chwo kata mon. Un duto koro un gimoro achiel ei Kristo Yesu.
Omiyo ka un jo-Kristo, to mano nyiso ni un koth Ibrahim, kendo un jocham girkeni ma nosingi.

items.text: Gima awachonu ema: Ka jacham girkeni pod en nyathi, to oonge pogruok gi misumba, kata obedo ni mwandu duto mar wuon dala osedongʼne.
Ka pod otin, to chune ni nyaka otim gik ma joritne gi jorit mwandu wuon dwaro mondo otim, korito kinde mane wuon-gi ochano mondo jotijego oket mwandu duto e lwete.
Kamano bende kane pod wan nyithindo, ne oketwa wasumbini mag timbe machon mag piny.
To ka kinde mane Nyasaye ochano nochopo, to nooronwa Wuode mane dhako onywolo, kendo mane onywol e bwo Chik,
mondo ores joma Chik otweyo, eka mondo wadok nyithind Nyasaye machamo mwandune.
To nikech un nyithind Nyasaye, Nyasaye oseoro bende Roho mar Wuode e chunywa. Roho maywakne Nyasaye niya, "
Abba!
Wuora."
Omiyo koro ok un wasumbini, to un nyithind ot, to nikech un nyithind ot, Nyasaye osemiyo wadoko jocham girkeni.
Paulo okecho jo-Galatia
Chon kane pod ukia Nyasaye, ne un wasumbini mag gik ma ok onego kwan kaka nyiseche.

To ka koro usengʼeyo Nyasaye, kata kawacho e yo machielo maber moloyo ka koro Nyasaye osengʼeyou, to ere kaka uchako udok e timbe machon mag piny, mayom yom kendo maonge teko? Udwaro ni timbegi ochak oketu wasumbini kendo?
Uketo chunyu mar rito odiechienge moyiedhi, kod dweche gi ndalo kod higni!
Ulitna ahinya, kendo timbeu miyo aparo ni dipo nine ayalonu Injili kayiem nono.
Jowetena, akwayou ni mondo uchal koda, mana kaka an asebedo machal kodu. Pok uchwanya e yo moro amora.
Ungʼeyo ni e limbena mokwongo tuo mane atuogo ema nomiyo ayudo thuolo mar yalonu Injili.

To kata obedo ni ne atuo kamano, to ne ok uchaya, kendo ne ok ujara. Kar timo kamano, to ne urwaka gi luor mana ka gima ne urwako malaika mar Nyasaye; chutho ne urwaka mana ka gima ne an Kristo Yesu owuon.
To tinde ere mor mane un-go mokwongo? Anyalo wacho ni kane alimou mokwongo, to ne urwaka gi mor maduongʼ ma kata mana wengeu ne unyalo miya.
Dipo ni asedoko jasiku nikech awachonu adiera?
Jogo to ero temo ywayou korgi, to ngʼeuru ni gitimo kamano mana mar kethou. Gima gitemo timo en mana mondo gipogu kodwa, mondo gin ema umigi duongʼ moloyo wan.
To onge wach, chiwruok gi mor ber abera, makmana ni nyaka utim kamano kuom timo gima ber. To dine ber moloyo kutimo kamano kinde duto, kata antie kata aonge.
Nyithinda mahero, awinjo rem mana ka dhako mamuoch kayo, ka agombo mondo Kristo onywol eiu.
To dobedo maber ka an kodu sani mondo awuo kodu wangʼ gi wangʼ eka uwinj dwonda maber, nimar chunya chandore ahinya nikech un.
Hagar kod Sara
Nyisaneuru un joma dwaro bedo e bwo chik, donge ungʼeyo gima chik wacho?
Ungʼeyo ni nondiki ni Ibrahim ne nigi yawuowi ariyo, ma achiel kuomgi nonywol gi dhako ma misumba, to machielo to nonywol gi dhako ma thuolo.
Wuod dhako ma misumbano nonywol kuom dwaro mar dhano, to wuod dhako ma thuolo nonywol kuom singruok.
Tiend wechegi opondo, nikech mon ariyogi ochungʼ kar singruok ariyo. Singruok achiel oa Got Sinai, kendo onywolo nyithindo monego obed wasumbini: Ma en Hagar.
Hagar ochungʼ kar Got Sinai mantie e piny jo-Arabu, kendo godno chalo gi dala maduongʼ mar Jerusalem nikech osiko e tich misumba gi nyithinde nyaka kawuono.
To Jerusalem moger malo ni thuolo kendo en e minwa,
mana kaka ondiki ni:
"Bed mamor, in dhako ma migumba,
in ma ok inywol nyithindo;
tingʼ dwondi malo ka igoyo koko gi ilo,
in mane muoch ok okayi;
nimar dhako ma migumba nobed gi nyithindo mangʼeny,
moloyo dhako man-gi dichwo."
Kuom mano un owetena, un koro un nyithind singruok mana kaka Isaka.
To mana kaka e kindeno wuowi mane onywol kuom dwaro mar dhano nosando wuowi mane onywol gi teko mar Roho Maler, e kaka timore bende e kindeni.
Muma to wacho angʼo kuom wachni? Owacho niya, "Riemb dhako ma misumbani kod wuode nimar wuod dhako ma misumbani ok nobed jacham girkeni kaachiel gi wuod dhako ma ni thuoloni."
Kuom mano owetena, ok wan nyithind dhako ma misumba, to wan koth dhako man thuolo.

items.text: Thuolo ma ngʼato nigo kuom Kristo
Kristo nogonyowa mondo wabed joma ni thuolo. Omiyo chungʼuru motegno, kendo kik uyie tingʼ mapek kurwako jok mar wasumbini kendo.
Winjuru gima awachonu maber! An Paulo asiemou ni ka uyie mondo oteru nyangu, to bedo ja-Kristo ok nokonyu.
To bende awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moter nyangu nigi gowi mar chopo Chike Musa mamoko duto.
In mitemo bet e winjruok gi Nyasaye kuom mako chik, ngʼeni isepogori gi Kristo; kendo isea kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
Wan to Roho ema miyo wabedo gi geno ni wabiro bedo e winjruok gi Nyasaye kuom yie.
Nikech kuom Kristo Yesu onge pogruok bed ni ngʼato oter nyangu kata ok otere. Gimoro achiel kende madwarore en yie matiyo kuom hera.
Jo-Galatia, yande uringo ngʼwech maber, en ngʼa moseduodou motamou luwo adiera?
Gima otimorenuno ok oa kuom Jal mane oluongou.
Ungʼeyo ngero mawacho niya, "Thowi matin ema miyo mogo modwal kuot."
An gi geno kuom Ruoth ni ok ubi yie rwako paro moro mopogore moa kuom ngʼat machielo. To ngʼatno mosewitou gi puonj mobamno nyaka Nyasaye bi kume, kata bed ni en ngʼama nade.
Jowetena, kaponi pod ayalo wach tero nyangu, to ere gima omiyo pod isanda kama? Ka kamano to kare puonj ma apuonjo mar msalaba dine ok okelo chwanyruok.
Joma thagougo, to daher mondo gidhi nyime ka gitimo mano nyaka gihinyre kendgi giwegi!
Jowetena, Nyasaye noluongou mondo ubed thuolo. To kik uti gi thuolo ma un-go mondo utim timbe maricho ma ringreu gombo timo. Kar timo kamano, to ngʼato ka ngʼato onego kony nyawadgi kuom hera.
Nikech Chik duto ichopo kare mana gi chik achiel mawacho niya, "Her wadu kaka iherori iwuon."
To ka ukaru kendo ukidhoru kendu mana ka ondiegi, to tangʼuru, nono to ubiro tiekoru.
Ngima kuom Roho
Omiyo akwayou ni mondo uwuothi kuom Roho, eka ok ubi timo gik ma ringreu dwaro.
Nikech ringruok osiko ka dwaro timo mana gik ma Roho ok dwar, to Roho bende dwaro chopo gik ma ringruok ok dwar. Gik moko ariyogi osiko ok winjre kendo mano ema miyo ok utim gik mabeyo mugombo timo.
To ka Roho ema otelonu, to koro ok un e bwo Chik.
Timbe mag ringruok nenore ratiro, gin kaka: chode, timbe mochido, anjawo,
lamo nyiseche manono, jwok, sigu, dhawo, nyiego, mirima, ichlit, miero; pogruok e kanyakla,
kod gombo; mer, dwanyruok, gi timbe mamoko mobam machal gi mago. To asiemou kaka nasiemou kinde motelo, ni joma timo timbe ma kamagi ok noyud gweth mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
To gik ma Roho nyago gin hera, mor, kwe, horuok, ngʼwono, ber, bedo ja-adiera,
dimbruok kod ritruok. Onge chik moro amora makwedo gik ma kamago.
Jo-Kristo Yesu madier duto oseguro e msalaba kit dhano machon gi gombone duto kod dwarone.
Nikech wadak kuom Roho, wasikuru mana ka wawuotho kuom Roho.
Kik wawuondre kendwa wawegi, ka wasiko mana ka wakwinyore kendo wagombo gige jowadwa.

items.text: Timo maber ne ji duto
Jowetena, ka ojuk ngʼato katimo richo, to un joma nigi Roho onego uduoge gi chuny mamuol, kuritoru uwegi mondo kik udonj e tem.
Kawuru tingʼ mag jowadu, nikech kutimo kamano eka uchopo chik Kristo.
To ka ngʼato okawore moketore e duongʼ ma oongego, to ngʼatno wuondore owuon.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka non wuodhe owuon eka doyud gima dopakrego kuom tich maber mosetimo kik ipiem gi ngʼat machielo,
nimar ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi morome.
Ngʼat mipuonjo Kristo nyaka pogne japuonjne gik moko duto mabeyo.
Kik uwuondru kendu, Nyasaye ok nyal wuondi. Ngʼeuru gima ichwoyo ema ikayo.
Ngʼat ma ochwoyo kuom ringruok, noka kethruok, to ngʼat ma ochwoyo kuom Roho, noka ngima mochwere.
Omiyo kik waol gi timo timbe mabeyo, nikech ka ok waol to wabiro keyo, ka ndalo ochopo.
Emomiyo, e kinde duto mwayudoe thuolo, to ber mondo watim maber ni ji duto, to moloyo ni kanyakla mar joma oyie.
Weche mogik
Neyeuru kaka lweta awuon ema ondikonu baruwani gi nukta madongo dongo!
Jogo madwaro nyisore kuom gik maokogo to temo chunou ni nyaka teru nyangu. To gimomiyo gitimo ma en mana ni mondo gitony e sand mochomogi nikech wach msalap Kristo.
Kata mana joma chunou mondo teru nyangu bende ok rit chik. Un to gichunou mondo giyud thuolo mar sungore nikech gima otim e ringre.
An to ok anyal sungora e ringruok ngangʼ. Gima dimi asungra en mana msalap Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, mosemiyo piny kod dwarone ogur e ngimana.
Nikech kata bed ni ngʼato oter nyangu kata ok otere ok lich, to gima dwarore en ni ochwe ngʼato chwech manyien.
Kwe gi ngʼwono obed ni ji duto moyie luwo chikni, kendo kata ni Israel mar Nyasaye.
Mogik, kik ngʼato angʼata koro kelna chandruok, nimar ringra opongʼ gi mbelni ma aseyudo kaka jaote Yesu.
Jowetena, mad ngʼwono mar Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo rit chunyu. Amin.
